panels.title: Airflow Workflow Status
panels.description: Latest NetPulse analytics orchestration outcome. Displays no_runs until Airflow completes its first attempt.

targets.rawSql: (SELECT status, source_status, from_date, through_date, attempt_count, source_observation_count, daily_mismatch_rows, incident_mismatch_rows, failed_task_id, error_type, started_at, completed_at, duration_seconds FROM v_analytics_workflow_status ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT 'no_runs' AS status, 'not_applicable' AS source_status, NULL::date AS from_date, NULL::date AS through_date, 0 AS attempt_count, 0::bigint AS source_observation_count, NULL::bigint AS daily_mismatch_rows, NULL::bigint AS incident_mismatch_rows, NULL::text AS failed_task_id, NULL::text AS error_type, NULL::timestamptz AS started_at, NULL::timestamptz AS completed_at, NULL::numeric AS duration_seconds WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_analytics_workflow_status)
